'''White wolves''' were found in the [[Burthorpe]] and [[Taverley]] area. They replaced the [[troll commando|Troll melee]], [[Troll mage commando|mage]] and [[Troll range commando|range commando]]s that used to be found there, and were later replaced with [[rabbit (Burthorpe)|rabbits]].

They have a number of low level drops designed to help new players, including [[mindspike]]s, [[quickbow]]s and [[keenblade]]s. These wolves do not count towards [[wolf]] [[Slayer]] tasks.
